response.text: {"label": "protocol_misunderstanding", "reason": "The sub pulses s_axis_tvalid for one clock and drops it without waiting for tready, so the first frame is lost (it was driven before the late reset pulse) and the 3c byte is only accepted when the transmitter is idle (sub `49 ... tx hs 3c` then `50 ... tx busy_rise 0`). It never rises while busy and holds until loaded, as gold does (`2 ... tx busy_rise 0`, `83 ... tx hs 3c`)."}
